snippet.description:

snippet.title: Two Pregnancies at Once! 😳 | Heterotopic Pregnancy
snippet.description:
ಒಂದು pregnancy ಇದೆ ಎಂದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೆವು... ಆದರೆ scan ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿದ್ದು ಎರಡು pregnancies! 😳❤️

ಇದು ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಒಂದು rare and unexpected case.

ಎರಡು ವಾರಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ IVF ಮೂಲಕ pregnancy ಆದ ಒಬ್ಬ patient ನಮ್ಮ clinic ಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದರು.

Scan ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಗರ್ಭಕೋಶದ ಒಳಗೆ ಮಗು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ಎಲ್ಲವೂ normal ಆಗಿತ್ತು. ಆಕೆಯೂ ತುಂಬಾ ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ❤️

ಆದರೆ clinic ಇಂದ ಹೊರಡುವಾಗ ಅವರು ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ ಹೇಳಿದರು...

“Doctor, ನನಗೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯ ಒಂದು ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಾಗ pain ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ.”

ಆ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನನಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಅನುಮಾನ ಬಂತು. ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಏನೋ ಸರಿಯಿಲ್ಲ ಅನಿಸಿತು.

ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ scan ಮಾಡಿ, Fallopian tubes ಕೂಡ check ಮಾಡಿದೆ.

ಆಗ ಗೊತ್ತಾದದ್ದು ಏನೆಂದರೆ...

ಗರ್ಭಕೋಶದ ಒಳಗೆ ಒಂದು pregnancy ಇತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು pregnancy Fallopian tube ಒಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು! 😮

ಈ ಅಪರೂಪದ condition ಅನ್ನು Heterotopic Pregnancy ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.

ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು pregnancy uterus ಒಳಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು uterus ಹೊರಗೆ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ Fallopian tubeನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

Tube rupture ಆದರೆ ಒಳಗೆ ತೀವ್ರ bleeding ಆಗಿ ತಾಯಿಯ ಜೀವಕ್ಕೂ ಅಪಾಯವಾಗಬಹುದು.

ತಕ್ಷಣ emergency treatment ನೀಡಿ, tubeನಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದ pregnancyಯನ್ನು remove ಮಾಡಿ...

snippet.title: South America or Pluto: which one is actually bigger?
snippet.description:
Pluto is tiny for a world, but its whole surface is about 17.74 million square kilometres. The 12 countries of South America add up to almost exactly the same.

It's a tie until French Guiana shows up, and French Guiana belongs to France. So South America only wins with a little help from Europe.

The music is the data: each note climbs with how much of Pluto is covered.

Sources: NASA, CIA World Factbook

22.Bölüm Özeti:
Hasan ölümle burun buruna gelirken Uzay, bencilliğine rağmen kaçmayı başaramaz. Uzay’dan hesap sormaya hazırlanan Emir ve arkadaşları büyük bir duvara toslar. İzledikleri görüntülerden sonra hiçbir şey eskisi gibi olmayacaktır. Ne çiftler için ne de Hasan için.  
Rami’nin yaralanması ise Fahriye’yi duygularıyla yüzleşmeye zorlarken Gülten ve Soner’in varlığı işleri iyice karıştırır. Melek ise ailesiyle bağları kopma noktasına gelirken henüz son sözünü söylemeye niyeti yoktur.
Cezaevinde yaşananlar Hasan’ın geçmişteki yaralarını yeniden açarken; Emir, kardeşi için kendisini feda etmeye hazırdır. Naz ise çırpınıyordur Emir için. Ne kadar kırgın olsa da Emir, Naz onu yalnız bırakmamaya kararlıdır.
Tüm bunlar olurken Zafer kazandığını zanneden Uzay’ı da büyük bir sürpriz bekliyordur. Hiç ummadığı anda Hasan’la aynı cezaevine düşerler…
İkisinin de bilmediği şey ise kaderin ikisi için de başka bir planı olduğudur.


"Altı Üstü İstanbul", İstanbul’un kenar mahallesinde yaşayan Emir’in bir grup arkadaşıyla birlikte hayallerine ulaşma mücadelesini konu alıyor. Güç, para ve ihanetin gölgesinde yolları kesişen gençler, attıkları her adımla birbirlerinin kaderini değiştirecek geri dönüşü olmayan seçimlerle yüzleşecek.
 
Dostlukların sınandığı, aşkların yön değiştirdiği ve herkesin kendi yolunu seçtiğini sandığı hikâyede, aslında hiçbir kararın tek başına alınmadığı ortaya çıkacak.

snippet.title: ONE POT VEGETABLE PULAO 🍚 #chefdinu
snippet.description:
Chef Dinu Style | 1 kg Basmati Rice

Ingredients

- Basmati Rice – 1 kg
- Water – 1.5 litres
- Milk – 100–150 ml
- Ghee – 150 g
- Onion – 200 g
- Ginger – 50 g
- Garlic – 50 g
- Mint Leaves – ½ bunch
- Mixed Vegetables – 500–800 g
  (Carrot, Beans, Cauliflower, Potato & Green Peas)
- Salt – To taste
- Sugar – 1 tbsp
- Cardamom Powder – 1 tsp
- Rose Water – ½ tsp

Ghee Usage

- 25 g – For tempering
- 25 g – During final dum
- Remaining ghee – As required during cooking

Final Dum

- Ghee – 25 g
- Cardamom Powder – 1 tsp
- Rose Water – ½ tsp
- Dum Cooking – 20 minutes

---

Description

Aromatic, flavourful and perfectly cooked Vegetable Pulao made using a simple one-pot method! 🍚

This pulao is loaded with colourful vegetables, fragrant basmati rice, fresh mint, aromatic cardamom and a touch of ghee and milk for that rich flavour.

No complicated cooking, just simple ingredients and a delicious homemade pulao that's perfect for lunch, dinner or special occasions.

Try this easy One Pot Vegetable Pulao recipe at home and enjoy restaurant-style flavour with simple cooking! ❤️
